name: PLangRec 3fb01dd
about: character-level bidirectional LSTM per line (first 40 characters of each stripped line) + stacking meta-model over the line predictions (Future Generation Computer Systems 166, 2025); trained on 8.5 million GitHub files of 21 languages labelled by extension and checked with ANTLR grammars; reads the text only, every line; answers its top language (no threshold); TensorFlow 2.15.0
